note: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule id is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (GRAPH_RULES_IMPLEMENTED); verify_all.py fails if the two sets differ. Every rule was checked against the classifier's real per-route sequences (templates/routes.json classifiedSequence) when written; verify_all re-runs all of them over those sequences.

rules.description: Exactly one HERO-category section per page (the page opener).
exceptions: template.notice: no hero; the protected-work notice is the whole compact page (templates.json noHero)

rules.description: The HERO directly follows shell.header; HERO means the page-opening composition only.
Exactly one shell.header (first) and one shell.footer (last).
conversion.closing appears at most once and directly before shell.footer (true on all 10 routes that have one; home and the notice page have none).
Section contracts' constraints.maxPerPage (HERO sections, casestudy.summary, casestudy.chapter-nav: 1).
Two scroll-driven narratives are never adjacent (the story page separates its storyboard and stepper with other sections).
Adjacent chapters should not share the same non-plain tone (tint/dark); the source alternates plain and tinted chapters.
At most two pinned scroll narratives per page (the source maximum, on the story page).
Runtime UI sections (overlayOnly) are listed under overlays, never as in-flow nodes; overlays must be allowed by the template.
Every node's motion.reducedMotionFallback equals the fallback pinned for its pattern (tokens/00-foundation/motion-patterns.json, MOTION_FALLBACK in the validator).
